entry.title: Invited talk at Zhejiang Gongshang University

link.title: Invited talk at Zhejiang Gongshang University

entry.content:
Invited by Dr. Siqi Wang, I recently gave a talk at the seminar hosted by the School of Economics at Zhejiang Gongshang University in Hangzhou.

During the presentation, I introduced my recent work on the network-based investigation of negative social influence.
entry.summary: Invited talk at Zhejiang Gongshang University

entry.title: CMAISS workshop will be held in Hamburg

link.title: CMAISS workshop will be held in Hamburg

entry.content: The Computational Modeling and Artificial Intelligence for Social Systems (CMAISS) workshop will be held in Hamburg together with the International Conference on Computational Science (29 June - 1 July). Jaeyoung Kwak (NTU) and I will co-chair the workshop.
entry.summary: CMAISS workshop will be held in Hamburg
